title: Home Feedback
description: Masukan sopan soal tugas rumah, PR, dan pekerjaan rumah tangga.

items.prompt: How do you give the feedback?
items.promptStructure: Wh-question: Wh-word + Auxiliary + Subject + Verb (+ Object)
items.promptStructureId: Pertanyaan Wh: Wh-word + Auxiliary + Subjek + Kata kerja (+ Objek)

choices.text: This is messy.
choices.textId: Ini berantakan.

choices.text: The answers are there, but three sentences are hard to read. Please rewrite those lines.
choices.textId: Jawabannya ada, tapi tiga kalimat sulit dibaca. Tolong tulis ulang baris itu.

choices.text: I'm not sure what to say.
choices.textId: Saya tidak yakin harus berkata apa.

choices.text: Someone else can deal with it later.
choices.textId: Orang lain bisa mengurusnya nanti.

items.explanation: Jawaban yang utuh untuk situasi ini: "The answers are there, but three sentences are hard to read. Please rewrite those lines." (Jawabannya ada, tapi tiga kalimat sulit dibaca. Tolong tulis ulang baris itu.). Pilihan lain terlalu pendek, menghindar, atau tidak menjawab permintaan.
